correctness.rationale: The exact normalized boundary law is the mixture with probabilities a/s and b/s of squared lengths ||v+Tu||² and ||u+Tv||². For formal indeterminates, integrating powers 1,2,3 yields M2=s²/3, M4=s⁴/5−4A²/3 and M6=s⁶/7−(12/5)s²A²+(16/5)abA², using A²=a²b²−(u·v)². Recovered s and A are positive; ab follows with division only by A²>0, then the side-length quadratic and acute edge-line angle yield congruence. The exact attainable range follows equivalently from A≤ab≤s²/4; rectangle/rhombus endpoints and the square coincidence are proved, and explicit rectangle versus rhombus of equal s,A proves minimality. Symbolic algebra, exact rational inversion, and numerical integrations independently reproduced computations.

value.rationale: The classical halving-pair continuum becomes a direction-unlabeled inverse measurement of an arbitrary parallelogram. The known second/fourth moments reveal only half-perimeter and area, with a continuum of compatible shapes. The first additional even moment yields the missing side product, a minimal exact reconstruction and a sharp attainable-moment band whose endpoints classify rectangles and rhombi. The original value is the complete inverse/feasibility classification, not merely computing one more moment or repeating known lower moments. Useful for geometric tomography and distinguishing shapes from population chord statistics, without claiming finite-sample stability.
